{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent primary endpoint definition between synopsis and body",
      "quote": "Primary Endpoint: Objective response rate (ORR), defined as the proportion of subjects with a confirmed objective response of complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) based on Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors version 1.1 (RECIST v1.1) as determined by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR)",
      "page": 5,
      "section": "Synopsis",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The synopsis defines the primary endpoint as ORR by BICR, but the body text (if present) may use investigator assessment or iRECIST, leading to inconsistency.",
      "fix": "Ensure the body text's primary endpoint analysis matches the synopsis (BICR, RECIST v1.1)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Contraception duration inconsistent with protocol section reference",
      "quote": "be willing to use an adequate method of contraception (Section 4.3.2.) from the time of consent until at least 150 days after last dose of study treatment.",
      "page": 8,
      "section": "Inclusion Criteria",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The inclusion criteria reference Section 4.3.2 for contraception, but the protocol lacks a dedicated contraception section (M11 5.4 is missing), and the duration (150 days) may not align with nivolumab's longer half-life recommendations.",
      "fix": "Add a detailed contraception section and verify the duration against regulatory guidance."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing trial schema and design rationale",
      "quote": "Methodology: This is a multicenter, open-label, Phase 2 clinical study of CMP-001 administered by IT injection in combination with intravenous (IV) nivolumab",
      "page": 6,
      "section": "Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol lacks a trial schema (M11 1.2) and a rationale for the trial design (M11 4.2), which are essential for understanding the study flow and justifying the open-label, single-arm design.",
      "fix": "Add a trial schema figure and a section explaining the rationale for the design choices."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inclusion criterion for prior radiation is ambiguous",
      "quote": "Documented disease progression in any lesion that was previously radiated in order to serve as a target lesion.",
      "page": 7,
      "section": "Inclusion Criteria",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The criterion is unclear: it does not specify the time frame for progression after radiation or whether the progression must be within the radiated field, leading to potential misinterpretation.",
      "fix": "Clarify the required timing and location of progression relative to radiation."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exclusion criterion for prior immune-related AE lacks detail",
      "quote": "History of immune-related AE that required permanent discontinuation of PD-1 blocking antibody.",
      "page": 8,
      "section": "Exclusion Criteria",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The criterion does not specify which immune-related AEs are excluded (e.g., all grades or only severe), and whether exceptions apply, which could lead to inconsistent enrollment.",
      "fix": "Specify the grades and types of immune-related AEs that lead to exclusion."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing details on trial stopping rules and end of trial",
      "quote": "All enrolled subjects will receive CMP-001 IT and nivolumab IV according to the treatment schedule until a reason for treatment discontinuation is reached.",
      "page": 6,
      "section": "Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not define trial stopping rules (M11 4.3) or the start and end of trial definitions (M11 4.4), which are critical for safety and regulatory compliance.",
      "fix": "Add sections for trial stopping rules and clear definitions of trial start and end."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent use of 'refractory' definition",
      "quote": "Refractory to PD-1 blockade either as monotherapy or in combination with other therapies, as defined by the following criteria: a. Received treatment with a Food and Drug Administration approved PD-1 blocking antibody for 12 weeks or longer. b. Have PD (according to RECIST v1.1) within 12 weeks of the last dose",
      "page": 7,
      "section": "Inclusion Criteria",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The definition of 'refractory' is detailed in the synopsis but may not be consistently applied in the body text, especially regarding the confirmatory assessment timing and exceptions for adjuvant therapy.",
      "fix": "Ensure the body text uses the same definition and includes all nuances from the synopsis."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing information on post-trial access and ancillary care",
      "quote": "Access to Trial Intervention After End of Trial (missing)",
      "page": 0,
      "section": "M11 4.5",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not describe whether subjects will have access to CMP-001 or nivolumab after the trial ends, nor does it address ancillary and post-trial care (SPIRIT 34), which is an ethical and regulatory requirement.",
      "fix": "Add a section describing post-trial access and ancillary care provisions."
    }
  ]
}
